messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today about the mobile app modernisation project. To start off, could you tell me about the high-level goals you have for the new mobile banking app? What are you hoping to achieve with this update?

Hey! Thanks for having me. I guess my main goal is to have an app that feels really modern and works quickly, like Revolut does. I want to be able to see what's happening with my money right away—like when money leaves my account, I want to get a notification instantly. It would also be great if I could freeze my card on my own if I lose it, without having to contact anyone. Just things that make managing my money easier and more straightforward, you know?

That sounds really interesting! So, just to clarify, you want the app to have features like real-time notifications for transactions and a self-service option to freeze your card. Are there any other specific features or functionalities you think would make managing your money easier?

Yeah, definitely! I think it would be super helpful to have a way to see how much I’m spending each month, maybe broken down by different things like groceries or dining out. It would help me keep track of my budget. Also, it would be nice if I could set up spending limits for different categories and get an alert if I’m getting close to them. Just things that help me manage my money better, you know?

Got it! So you’re looking for features that help with budgeting, like tracking monthly spending by category and setting up spending limits with alerts. That sounds really useful! Are there any limitations or restrictions you think we should keep in mind while developing these features?

Honestly, I haven't really thought about any limitations. I'm just focused on what would make the app work better for me. I guess as long as it all works smoothly and doesn't have any weird hiccups, that would be important. But yeah, I’m mostly just thinking about the features that would help me out.

That makes sense! So, to summarize, you're mainly focused on features that improve usability and money management, like real-time notifications, the ability to freeze your card, budgeting tools, and spending limits. One last question—can you give me an example of how you envision interacting with these budgeting features in the app?

Sure! I imagine it would be cool to open the app and easily see a summary of my spending right on the home screen. Like, maybe a pie chart or something that shows how much I’ve spent in different categories. Then, I could click on a category, set a budget for it, and get a notification if I’m getting close to hitting that limit. Just something that feels easy and quick to use, you know? I want it to be really straightforward.

Thanks for that example! So, just to confirm, you’d like a home screen summary with visual representations of your spending, like a pie chart, and the ability to click into categories to set budgets and receive notifications when you're nearing those limits. That helps a lot! 

Okay, I think I have enough information for now. Here are the requirements you've shared: 

1. Real-time notifications for transactions.
2. Ability to freeze the card through the app.
3. Monthly spending tracking broken down by categories.
4. Spending limits for different categories with alerts when approaching limits.
5. A user-friendly home screen summary with visual representations of spending.

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
